incidents_catalogued.title: C16 Best Epoch Narrative Contradiction
incidents_catalogued.reported_in_c18: Section 11 Table & Section 1 stated best DEV mIoU was achieved at epoch 4.
incidents_catalogued.actual_machine_truth: Best DEV mIoU was achieved at epoch 17 (0.049399). Early stopping triggered at epoch 27 (17 + 10).
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Typographical transcription error in C18 markdown report compilation.
incidents_catalogued.resolution: C19 audited metrics.json line 7, epoch_history.json, and execution logs, restoring epoch 17 as machine truth. Codified under GOV-RULE-097.

incidents_catalogued.title: Optimizer and Training Protocol Hyperparameter Drift in C18 Table
incidents_catalogued.reported_in_c18: Section 11 table listed lr=3e-4, wd=1e-4, 20 epochs, accumulation=1, effective_bs=8.
incidents_catalogued.actual_machine_truth: C15 frozen protocol and C16 actual execution used lr=5e-4, wd=0.01, 30 epochs budget (3 warmup, 27 decay), accumulation=2, effective_bs=16.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Template contamination from default unverified hyperparameter drafts in C18 report synthesis.
incidents_catalogued.resolution: C19 formally purged the 3e-4 / 1e-4 / 20 epoch / accumulation 1 values and reaffirmed the verified C15 canonical protocol. Codified under GOV-RULE-096 and GOV-RULE-099.

incidents_catalogued.title: Sampler Epoch Seed Formula Truncation
incidents_catalogued.reported_in_c18: Section 9 narrative stated seed formula as 'seed + epoch'.
incidents_catalogued.actual_machine_truth: Established protocol and actual C16 execution used 'base_seed + epoch * 1000'.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Omission of the '* 1000' factor in narrative text (despite JSON audit containing the correct formula).
incidents_catalogued.resolution: C19 locked the generator formula to 'base_seed + epoch * 1000' across all specifications. Reaffirmed under Level 4 authority.

incidents_catalogued.title: Canonical Taxonomy Terminology Drift ('AS' and 'Thermal')
incidents_catalogued.reported_in_c18: Section 4, 6, 8, 14, 15 introduced 'AS' and 'Thermal' and jumbled class indices.
incidents_catalogued.actual_machine_truth: Canonical taxonomy consists strictly of: 0 BG, 1 AF, 2 BS, 3 LWA, 4 MCC, 5 OF, 6 POW, 7 RF, 8 WS, 9 Eddy, 10 IWs, 11 HM.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Unauthorized synonym substitution and taxonomy reordering in retrospective reporting.
incidents_catalogued.resolution: C19 repudiated all occurrences of 'AS' and 'Thermal'. Reaffirmed the 12-class canonical taxonomy under GOV-RULE-095.

incidents_catalogued.title: Input Tensor Dimensions Stated as [1, 512, 512]
incidents_catalogued.reported_in_c18: Section 7 narrative stated model input tensor shape as [1, 512, 512].
incidents_catalogued.actual_machine_truth: Physical samples are strictly 256x256; model input contract is [B, 1, 256, 256].
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Copy-paste formatting error from standard UNet documentation.
incidents_catalogued.resolution: C19 confirmed 100% of 212 samples are 256x256 and model operates on [B, 1, 256, 256]. Audited in ops02_c19_input_shape_audit_v1.json.

incidents_catalogued.title: Epistemic Overclaim on Tier-1 Cross-Domain Evaluation
incidents_catalogued.reported_in_c18: C18 claimed Tier 1 cross-evaluation would 'directly separate' distribution shift from optimization defect.
incidents_catalogued.actual_machine_truth: Cross-domain evaluation across confounded dataset pairs is descriptive evidence only and cannot causally isolate individual mechanisms.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Inductive leap conflating domain transfer diagnostics with controlled counterfactual ablation.
incidents_catalogued.resolution: C19 downgraded Tier 1 cross-evaluation to descriptive transfer evidence. Codified under GOV-RULE-098.
